constraints: If no attribute named attribName exists, an error is returned.
If several attributes share the same name, only the first one's value is returned.

overloadMerges.note: attribValue is a filled/returned variable (docs: 'Attribute value', direction '<-'); autoparse defaults all params to direction:in. Also documents the silent coercion to Text when the target variable has no declared type.

params.name: attribName
params.description: Name of the attribute to get the value of

params.name: attribValue
params.description: Receives the attribute's value, converted to the variable's declared type

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If attribValue's variable type is not defined, the value is returned as Text by default.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets the value of an XML element's attribute selected by name.
